SELECT I.INTF_ID AS intfId, I.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, I.TITLE AS title, I.PARTNER_SYS AS partnerSys, I.IF_TYPE AS ifType, TC.CODE_NM AS ifTypeNm, I.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, I.CHARGER_ID AS chargerId FROM OPS_INTERFACE I LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON I.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE TC ON TC.CODE_GRP = 'INTF_TYPE' AND TC.CODE_ID = I.IF_TYPE LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'INTF_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = I.STATUS WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY I.INTF_ID DESC OFFSET #{firstIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{recordCountPerPage} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_INTERFACE I WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT I.INTF_ID AS intfId, I.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, I.TITLE AS title, I.PARTNER_SYS AS partnerSys, I.IF_TYPE AS ifType, TC.CODE_NM AS ifTypeNm, I.DATA_DESC AS dataDesc, I.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, I.REQ_ID AS reqId, TO_CHAR(I.REQ_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reqDt, I.CHARGER_ID AS chargerId, TO_CHAR(I.PLAN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS planDt, TO_CHAR(I.COMPLETE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS completeDt, I.RESULT AS result, TO_CHAR(I.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS regDt FROM OPS_INTERFACE I LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON I.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE TC ON TC.CODE_GRP = 'INTF_TYPE' AND TC.CODE_ID = I.IF_TYPE LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'INTF_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = I.STATUS WHERE I.INTF_ID = #{intfId}

SELECT H.HIS_ID AS hisId, H.INTF_ID AS intfId, H.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, H.CONTENT AS content, H.PROC_ID AS procId, TO_CHAR(H.PROC_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS procDt FROM OPS_INTERFACE_HIS H LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'INTF_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = H.STATUS WHERE H.INTF_ID = #{intfId} ORDER BY H.HIS_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_INTERFACE (SYS_ID, TITLE, PARTNER_SYS, IF_TYPE, DATA_DESC, STATUS, REQ_ID, REQ_DT, CHARGER_ID, PLAN_DT, RESULT, REG_DT) VALUES (#{sysId}, #{title}, #{partnerSys}, #{ifType}, #{dataDesc}, #{status}, #{reqId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{chargerId}, TO_DATE(#{planDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')NULL, #{result}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
INSERT INTO OPS_INTERFACE_HIS (INTF_ID, STATUS, CONTENT, PROC_ID, PROC_DT) VALUES (#{intfId}, #{status}, #{content}, #{procId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
